Tier 1 email verified allows 10 vCPU/10 GiB RAM/30 GiB storage per tier table; docs show a contradictory 20GiB in lower limits table. Official Daytona pricing lists $0.0504/vCPU-hour + $0.0162/GiB-hour + $0.000108/GiB storage-hour after 5 free GiB; example 4 vCPU/8GiB = $0.3312/hour compute, 4 vCPU/16GiB = $0.4608/hour compute, excluding chargeable storage/network/taxes. $200 free compute baseline, no card for initial trial. Tier 1 documented quota 10vCPU/10GiB total resources (limits table also says 20GiB memory); Tier 2 requires linked card and $25 top-up for 100vCPU/200GiB. Therefore 16GB requires paid verification/tier, and free tier 8GB may constrain concurrent builds. No new BF offer.
